ExtensionHookOnError.description:
What the daemon does when a call of a hook fails: the plugin times out,
is not connected or exits, answers with an error, or answers with a
result that does not decode (an unknown action included).

Open: a policy this build does not know reads as `block`, the stricter
one.

oneOf.description: The operation goes on as if the plugin had not intercepted it.
The operation is blocked or refused.

hook.description: The name of a hook, as a snake-case label.

intercept.description:
The hooks the plugin intercepts, each at most once. The daemon skips
an entry it cannot read, whose hook it does not know, or that repeats
a hook, with a diagnostic.

subscribe_events.description:
The types of the session events the plugin receives; empty for none.
The daemon skips a pattern it cannot read, with a diagnostic.

items.description: Event types: a type, a prefix ending in `*`, or `*` for every type.

RuntimeTools.description: A runtime's tools and their prompt sections.

ToolCollision.description:
How a tool behaves when another source offers the same name.

Open: a mode this build does not know reads as `prefix`.

oneOf.description: Hidden whenever a non-fallback tool with the same name is published.

Takes the bare name, and the tool it collides with is published under
its own source's prefix (or hidden, if it is `fallback`). Two
`override` tools with one name are both prefixed.

Takes the bare name while no other tool claims it. It is published as
`<source>_<name>` when a `prefix` tool of another source has the same
name, when one `override` tool takes the name, or when the name is a
base-layer tool's.

ToolConcurrency.description:
Declares whether calls to a tool may overlap with sibling calls from one model turn.

Open: a value this build does not know reads as `exclusive`, the most
conservative.

ToolDeclaration.description: A tool as a runtime declares it.

background_default.description:
Whether a call runs in the background when the model omits the
argument; only valid with `background`.

permission.description:
The fixed permission action the tool is checked under; absent for a
tool that needs no permission.

ToolResultTruncationPolicy.description:
Open: a policy this build does not know reads as `bounded`, so the
daemon still bounds the result.

features.description:
What the plugin's own configuration enables. None are defined yet;
the daemon ignores one it does not know, with a diagnostic.

summary.description:
What the plugin's tools are for, in a sentence or two: its summary in
deferred tool announcements (plugin protocol 1.25.0), cut to 4 KiB.

tools.description:
The plugin's tools and their prompt sections, declared as a runtime
declares them; it runs them with the runtime protocol's `tool/*`
messages.
